# Citation Request Template

> **Disclaimer:** Using this skill is not legal advice. It does not
> provide a valid legal defence for any infringement, misuse or other
> abuse of intellectual property or other rights. Responsibility for how
> material is used stays with the user. Get qualified legal advice where
> rights are in doubt.

For each item of third-party material cited or used, please provide:

1. The original author(s).
2. The source publication: its title, version or edition, publisher and
   publication date, plus a stable identifier (a standard number with its
   year, a DOI, an ISBN or a URL) and the date it was accessed.
3. The copyright or other rights holder, where different from the
   author(s). For example, ISO holds the copyright in the text of an
   ISO/IEC standard even where another body wrote its content.
4. The applicable licence, terms of use, or permission under which the
   material may be used.
5. Any attribution, notice, redistribution, modification, or other usage
   requirements associated with the material.
6. A brief description of how the material has been incorporated into
   this document (for example, reproduced verbatim, adapted, summarized,
   translated, illustrated, or otherwise derived).
7. Where the use goes beyond what the licence or terms in item 4 clearly
   permit (for example, reproducing text verbatim when the terms allow
   only reference), evidence of permission, consent, or other
   authorization. This isn't needed for material that is only summarized
   or referred to by clause where the terms allow it.

Please provide sufficient supporting information to allow the
provenance, ownership, and permitted use of the material to be
independently verified.

If this information can't be provided, the material will be removed from
the document or rewritten so that it no longer depends on the source.
